_comment: Reviewed contracts of pinned third-party MCP tools. Generated by scripts/sync_mcp_contracts.py -- do not hand-edit. Its diffs are the review material for upstream schema changes.

maxCharacters.description: Maximum characters to extract per page (default: 3000)

urls.description: URLs to read. Batch multiple URLs in one call.

numResults.description: Number of search results to return (default: 10).

objective.description: Goal for this search turn; say which documents should rank first, which should be excluded, and what specific facts or figures to pull from them.

query.description: Natural language search query. Should be a semantically rich description of the ideal page, not just keywords. Optionally include category:<type> (company, people) to focus results — e.g. 'category:people John Doe software engineer'.

pmid.description: One PubMed identifier to look up in Folklore's current corpus, as 1 to 12 digits without a PMID prefix.
pmid.title: Pmid

cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor from the preceding response for the same query and sort order; omit for the first page.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Maximum number of publications to return, from 1 to 25.
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Natural-language literature question or exact PMID, DOI, PMCID, gene, variant, phenotype, HPO, or OMIM query. Include every known publication identifier when comparing or finding related papers.
query.title: Query

sort.description: Result ordering: relevance-ranked, newest publication first, or oldest publication first.
sort.title: Sort

inputSchema.description: The only public scientific input admitted by the MCP tool.

assembly.description: Reference genome assembly. Folklore currently accepts GRCh38 only.
assembly.title: Assembly

query.description: One germline nuclear SNV or simple indel to resolve and interpret; accepted forms include coordinates, genomic/coding/protein HGVS, SPDI, rsID, or a returned Folklore canonical_key in GRCh38:chrN:position:REF:ALT form.
query.title: Query

region.title: Region

strand.description: 1 = plus (default), -1 = minus. find_genes (gene finding) is plus-oriented — keep 1 for annotation; use -1 only for a strand-sensitive task on a known minus-strand locus.
strand.title: Strand

model.description: Optional model id; omit for the task default. See list_models.

tss_index.description: 0-based offset of the transcription start site into the sequence, counted in bases (whitespace is ignored). Required unless the sequence is exactly 9,198 bp; must leave 4,599 bp on each side. The API scores only sequence[tss_index-4599 : tss_index+4599] and reports the slice it used as meta.task_specific_counts.scored_window — check it: a wrong-but-in-range offset scores the wrong window silently.
